name: symphony
description: High-performance TLS proxy with SNI routing — Rust/napi-rs, Linux

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && napi build --platform --js false --dts ts/addon.d.ts --release
scripts.build:debug: tsc -p tsconfig.json && napi build --platform --js false --dts ts/addon.d.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && napi prepublish -t npm
